scripts.dream: npm run build --workspace @interwebalchemy/engram-snapshot --if-present && npm run build --workspace @interwebalchemy/engram-dreams --if-present && node packages/dreams/dist/index.js
scripts.dream:cleanup: npm run build --workspace @interwebalchemy/engram-snapshot --if-present && npm run build --workspace @interwebalchemy/engram-core --if-present && npm run build --workspace @interwebalchemy/engram-dreams --if-present && node packages/dreams/dist/index.js --cleanup-only
scripts.snapshot: npm run build --workspace @interwebalchemy/engram-snapshot --if-present && node packages/snapshot/dist/index.js create
scripts.snapshot:list: npm run build --workspace @interwebalchemy/engram-snapshot --if-present && node packages/snapshot/dist/index.js list
scripts.snapshot:restore: npm run build --workspace @interwebalchemy/engram-snapshot --if-present && node packages/snapshot/dist/index.js restore
